QUOTE: A repo's own `index_scope:` declaration wins if it has one. Otherwise the scope is the whole repository... absent → None → fall through; present but unusable → _Rejected → whole-repo, with the reason recorded; "If no usable root survives, the declaration is rejected and the build falls back to the whole repo"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the declared index_scope is preferred and that absence, an unusable declaration, or no surviving roots all fall through to whole-repo indexing.
